pages.title: Ocean Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Craft it using the recipe on the next page.$(br2)§lCondition: §r Works while in a Curios slot, or in the main hand / off hand.$(br2)Abyssal Breath: oxygen always stays full, and you are immune to drowning damage.$(br)Embrace of the Current: swim speed increased by 200%, and water current push and Slowness are negated.$(br)Unblocked Abyss: immune to Mining Fatigue, and free of underwater and airborne mining penalties.$(br)Coral Blade: underwater mining speed increased by 25%.$(br)Tidal Kin: guardians will not attack you first.
